name: Clínica Baviera, S.A.
summary: Clínica Baviera, S.A., a medical company, provides ophthalmologic medicine services in Spain, Germany, and rest of Europe. The company offers refractive, presbyopia, and cataract surgeries; and oculoplastia, corneal disease, dry eye, strabismus, pediatric ophthalmology, glaucoma, neuro-ophthalmological, disorders, and blepharoplasty treatments. It also provides external and internal consultations, surgery treatments, and rehabilitation services. The company was formerly known as Clínica Oftalmológica Baviera, S.L. and changed its name to Clínica Baviera, S.A. in 2000.
